ft10.config.title: FT10 Settings
ft10.config.group.title: Title
ft10.config.enabled.desc: Track and show scores. Same as /ft on and /ft off.
ft10.config.goal.desc: Reaching this many kills against one opponent wins the set (VICTORY / DEFEAT). 0 turns it off.
ft10.config.autoNewSet.desc: After someone reaches the goal, start again at 0 - 0 and count sets won.
ft10.config.saveScores.desc: Keep scores (per server) after you leave or close the game.
ft10.config.shortAlias.desc: Also register /ft. Turn off if a server has its own /ft command. /ft10 always works. Applies when you rejoin.
ft10.config.resetServer.desc: Delete every score on the server you are playing on. Same as /ft reset all.
ft10.config.resetServer.confirm: Reset every score on this server?
ft10.config.resetServer.confirm.message: All scores and sets against every opponent on this server are deleted. This can't be undone.
ft10.config.resetEverything.desc: Delete every score on every server you have played on.
ft10.config.resetEverything.confirm: Reset all scores on every server?
ft10.config.resetEverything.confirm.mess: All scores and sets on every server are deleted. This can't be undone.
ft10.config.editHud.desc: Drag the score where you want it and scroll to resize. Also: /ft hud.
ft10.config.hudEnabled.desc: Show the score above the action bar.
ft10.config.hudVisibility.desc: Always, or only while you're fighting.
ft10.config.hudHideAfterSeconds.desc: In combat mode, hide the score this long after your last fight.
ft10.config.hudOffsetX.desc: Move the score left (negative) or right (positive).
ft10.config.hudOffsetY.desc: Move the score up (negative) or down (positive).
ft10.config.hudShadow.desc: Draw the score with a shadow.
ft10.config.hudShowName.desc: Show the opponent's name above the score.
ft10.config.hudShowGoal.desc: Show FT10 and the set score when a goal is set.
ft10.config.hudShowHeads.desc: Your head left of your score, your opponent's right of theirs.
ft10.config.colorSeparator.desc: Color of the dash between the numbers.
ft10.config.titleEnabled.desc: Show the new score as a title when a point is scored.
ft10.config.chatEnabled.desc: Add a line to your chat for each point. Only you see it; nothing is sent to the server.
ft10.config.soundEnabled.desc: Play a sound for each point.
ft10.config.combatTimeoutSeconds.desc: When no death message names the killer, the last player who hit the victim within this time gets the kill.
ft10.config.switchOnHit.desc: Show the score of whoever you start fighting. When off, only kills switch the opponent.
ft10.config.switchLockSeconds.desc: While you traded hits with the shown opponent this recently, someone else hitting you doesn't switch the screen.
ft10.config.usePresetPatterns.desc: Recognize common plugin kill messages like "X was slain by Y" and "Y killed X". Vanilla death messages always work.
ft10.config.customPatterns.desc: Your server's kill messages, as templates like "{victim} was killed by {killer}" (* matches anything) or as regular expressions with (?<victim>...) and (?<killer>...) groups. Without {killer} the player who hit the victim last gets the kill; without {victim} it is about you dying. For duel messages that only name the winner, use {winner} ("{winner} won the round *"). Turn on /ft debug and copy a message FT10 missed to get the exact text. Invalid patterns are dropped when saving.
ft10.config.countCombatLogs.desc: An opponent who leaves the server while fighting you counts as your kill.
ft10.config.useSidebarStats.desc: Watch "Kills" and "Deaths" lines in the sidebar. Catches kills on servers that respawn players without a real death. A counter going up by one is matched with the player you hit last.
ft10.config.statKillLabels.desc: Words in front of the kill counter in your server's sidebar, like "Kills".
ft10.config.statDeathLabels.desc: Words in front of the death counter in your server's sidebar, like "Deaths".
ft10.help.debug: explain every kill signal in chat; last: messages FT10 didn't recognize
ft10.debug.on: Debug on: FT10 explains every kill signal in chat. Only you see it. /ft debug again turns it off.
ft10.debug.message_guess: Kill message (%s): %s died, killer from recent hits · %s
ft10.debug.stat_kill_nobody: Sidebar kills %s → %s, but you hit nobody recently
ft10.debug.copy.hover: Copy this message, for a bug report or a custom pattern
ft10.debug.last.header: Last %s messages about a fight that FT10 didn't recognize:
ft10.debug.channel.title: title
ft10.debug.channel.subtitle: subtitle
